title: Rabbi Chelbo bar Chuna
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Jerusalem Talmud Nazir, beginning of chapter 3. Hyman calls this a scribal error, since the statement also appears in Jerusalem Talmud Moed Katan 3:1 with the reading “Rabbi Chelbo, R’ Chuna (Rav Huna) in the name of Rav.”[^1]

notes.text: The consulted Jerusalem Talmud Nazir 3:1 paragraph reads Rabbi Chelbo bar Chuna in Rabbi Yochanan’s name. The parallel in the consulted Moed Katan chapter 3 is at 3:5:2–3 and reads Rabbi Chelbo, Rav Chuna, in Rav’s name. Hyman supplies 3:1 for that parallel and judges the combined name to be a scribal error. His division, the parenthetical Rav Huna identification, and supplied locator remain his report; the differing transmission chains are not merged.
